description: Named summits imported from Overture Maps for "idaho-bogus-basin".  Heights are OpenStreetMap `ele` tags carried through Overture, never DEM samples.

sources.title: Overture Maps Foundation, base theme, type=land, release 2026-09-23.1 — summit features (subtype=physical, class=peak|volcano), © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0
sources.note: Position is the midpoint of Overture's float32-rounded `bbox` (sub-metre for a point feature); height is the `elevation` column, which carries the OpenStreetMap `ele` tag unchanged — verified row-by-row against the same rows' `source_tags.ele`. Heights are therefore tagged/surveyed values, NEVER DEM samples (MISSION.md: SRTM under-reads sharp summits by 250–350 m). Area imported: 43.2,-116.9 … 44.4,-115.3.
